name: 新三国 · 卡牌选取率排行（候选≥300）
description: 数据源 run_history.completed → card_choices。选取率 = 被选次数 / 候选次数，只统计候选次数 ≥300 的牌（Top 25）；x 轴为去掉 CARD.NEWSANGUO_CARD_ 前缀后的卡名。

source.query: SELECT substring(card_id, 21) AS card_label, count() AS offered, countIf(picked) AS picked, round(countIf(picked) / count(), 4) AS pick_rate FROM (SELECT JSONExtractString(choice, 'card', 'id') AS card_id, JSONExtractBool(choice, 'was_picked') AS picked FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(stats, 'card_choices')) AS choice FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(point, 'player_stats')) AS stats FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(act_points)) AS point FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractString(ifNull(properties.payload, ''), 'applicant_payload'), 'run_history'), 'map_point_history')) AS act_points FROM events WHERE event = 'run_history.completed')))) WHERE card_id != '' GROUP BY card_label HAVING offered >= 300 AND length(card_label) > 0 ORDER BY pick_rate DESC, offered DESC LIMIT 25
